title: Rs 500 banknotes remain legal tender
text: The Reserve Bank of India has not announced any plan to withdraw Rs 500 banknotes. Rs 500 notes continue to be legal tender and can be used for all transactions. Messages claiming that Rs 500 notes will be banned are false.

title: 500 रुपये के नोट वैध हैं
text: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक ने 500 रुपये के नोट बंद करने की कोई घोषणा नहीं की है। 500 रुपये के नोट वैध मुद्रा बने हुए हैं। 500 के नोट बंद होने का दावा करने वाले संदेश झूठे हैं।

title: Withdrawal of Rs 2000 notes
text: In May 2023 the Reserve Bank of India announced the withdrawal of Rs 2000 denomination banknotes from circulation. The notes continue to be legal tender.

title: Taj Mahal
text: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. It was commissioned in 1631 by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan.

title: Ranchi
text: Ranchi is the capital of the Indian state of Jharkhand. The city is known for its waterfalls, including Hundru Falls and Dassam Falls.

title: Chandrayaan-3
text: Chandrayaan-3 is a mission by the Indian Space Research Organisation. Its lander touched down near the lunar south pole on 23 August 2023, making India the first country to land near the south pole of the Moon.

title: Boiling point of water
text: At sea level, pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius. The boiling point decreases at higher altitudes because atmospheric pressure is lower.

title: गंगा नदी
text: गंगा भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी है। यह हिमालय में गंगोत्री हिमनद से निकलती है और बंगाल की खाड़ी में मिलती है।
